title: Risk from Inadequate Sleep and Irregular Schedules

supports.en: Linked from the challenge resource "Risks of Human Spaceflight". It is why M.A.T.E. surfaces a reduction of the planned rest window as a context change worth noticing. NASA names stressors "such as work overload, irregular light-dark cycles, and sleep-pattern disruptions". It does not support any prediction of how a person will sleep.
supports.es: Enlazado desde el recurso del desafío «Risks of Human Spaceflight». Es la razón por la que M.A.T.E. muestra una reducción de la ventana de descanso planificada como un cambio de contexto que vale la pena notar. NASA nombra factores de estrés «such as work overload, irregular light-dark cycles, and sleep-pattern disruptions». No respalda ninguna predicción sobre cómo dormirá una persona.

title: Risk of Inadequate Systems Operations Support

supports.en: Linked from the challenge resource "Risks of Human Spaceflight". NASA states the risk "of adverse mission outcomes due to Earth independent human-systems operation". It is why the onboard core computes and explains a schedule change locally, without real-time Ground support.
supports.es: Enlazado desde el recurso del desafío «Risks of Human Spaceflight». NASA enuncia el riesgo «of adverse mission outcomes due to Earth independent human-systems operation». Es la razón por la que el núcleo a bordo calcula y explica un cambio de agenda localmente, sin soporte de Tierra en tiempo real.
